integrity: All character sums in the proof use the unnormalized transform and exact arithmetic; the included checkers verify finite cases independently.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for ordinary proper four-colourings of triangular books and the two groups of order four. It does not cover arbitrary graphs or larger palettes. Historical priority has bounded-search uncertainty. Independent validation not performed.
title: Fourier rank separation between cyclic and Klein four-colour palettes on triangular books
